blockers.finding: The future Builder is explicitly allowed to add the new public functions in src/video_paper_wiki/upstream_adapter.py, but the same paragraphs call the accepted v1 implementation a frozen input. The accepted v1 implementation occupies that exact shared module, so a byte-level reading makes the only allowed production edit forbidden. The requirement to avoid widening old v1 behavior is sound, but the frozen unit is not defined as behavior/API/constants versus the complete module bytes.
blockers.impact: A conforming implementation cannot determine whether appending the new command-specific profile loader, snapshot code and APIs to the shared module violates the freeze. Reviewers could reject either required implementation or preservation of the old module, depending on interpretation.
blockers.required_correction: State that the accepted v1 contract, schema, profile, fixtures, public behavior, constants and goldens remain immutable, while src/video_paper_wiki/upstream_adapter.py is an expressly shared allowed path for branch-isolated additions. Require all existing v1 APIs/error order/profile selection/tests to remain unchanged; do not describe the complete prior module bytes as an immutable implementation input.
